thread:
elaine: Idea: try a stochastic per-layer quant rollout where each request samples a small subset of layers to run at low-bit (4-bit/INT8) and the rest at baseline (FP16). Goal: get more granular signal on which layers tolerate low precision without full-profile rollout.

rohit: Interesting. How do we avoid noisy outputs and keep deterministic replay?

elaine: We seed a per-request RNG with a stable hash (tenant+prompt+trace_id) so we can replay decisions. Also store the sampled-layer mask in trace logs.

marta: How will devex interpret results? We need stable metrics: per-layer token-loss, param-sensitivity, and downstream metric delta.

elaine: We'll aggregate per-layer deltas across prompts and produce an importance score. Use robust estimators (median) to avoid outlier prompts dominating.

ops_jen: Ops: runtime hotpath needs to be cheap. Sampling and branching could add latency. Can we do sampling only on shadow requests or a small percent of traffic?

elaine: Yes, sample rate tunable. Default 1% shadow-only. For canary customers we can raise to 5-10% with direct fallback routing if degradation exceeds threshold.

rohit: We must prevent attacker prompts from forcing worst-case masks. Add input-entropy based caps and dedupe repeated prompt hashes.

marta: For quality gating, define a per-layer tolerance score and mark layers as "safe" once they pass N samples with delta<epsilon. Then create refined quant profiles that lock in safe layers.

elaine: Exactly. After stabilization we bake a new profile that quantizes safe layers and run a standard canary before full rollout.

synth-bot: Note: Experiment ticket created: EXP-8721.

ops_jen: Rollback: emergency switch to `quant.stochastic_mode=false` and flush mask cache. Also have auto-fallback to baseline profile on spike detection.

rohit: Data storage: keep only aggregated sketches, not raw tokens. Keep sample seeds + masks for a 7-day window for replay.

marta: Action items: elaine draft experiment plan + metrics, rohit sketch replay harness, ops_jen write rollout/rollback snippet. Aim: experiment live next Tues.

elaine: Thanks team :rocket:
